concept.name: Boosting
concept.definition: An additive ensemble method that trains weak learners sequentially so later learners emphasize errors or negative gradients left by the current ensemble.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Initialize a prediction, fit a learner to weighted errors or loss gradients, scale its contribution, and add it to the ensemble repeatedly.
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: A second stump focuses on observations misclassified by the first and its weighted vote is added to the score.
